tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (āḥ)༄༅/ /dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi tho yig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad
(āḥ)༄༅/ /dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi tho yig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi tho yig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra wa ra hi ye/ 'dir bla ma dpyal pa rnams las brgyud pa'i rje btsun phag mo rig gsum bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la nub phyogs sam lho phyogs su kha bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes dag pa gsum gyi sngags lan gsum brjod nas de'i don bsam/ de nas rang gi lus khams gsum rnam par dag pa gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i rnam pa can du bsgoms pa'i dbus kyi lte bar pad nyi ro'i gdan la zhal gnyis ma dmar mo g.yas phag zhal g.yon lha yi zhal/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du bsams la oṃ gsum ma bzlas so// don grub ma dmar mo g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra wa ra hi ye a we sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzlas so// dbu bcad ma ser la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ g.yas gri gug gis rang gi dbu bcad nas g.yon pas steng phyogs su 'dzin pa/ g.yas gri gug 'og phyogs su brkyang ba/ g.yon du rdo rje rab bsngags ma ljang gu g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas su rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma ser mo g.yas brkyang pa/ gnyis ka'ang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// gsung rgyun rnying pa la 'di tsam zhig 'byung bas de kho na ltar ram/

sa bon la bskyed na zhal gnyis ma bam̐ dang*/ don grub ma hrīḥdang*/ dbu bcad ma bam̐ las yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed cing zhal gnyis ma la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ don grub ma la rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa dang*/ dbu bcad ma la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsgoms nas/ 'khor gnyis ni skad cig gis gsal btab pas kyang chog par mngon no// de ltar bdag bskyed gsum bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams mdun du bshams/ mchod pa'i bkod pa dang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi 'bri lugs ni dpe chung ltar yin la/ gtor ma ci tsam 'grub pa yin na yang med du mi rung ba sngon 'gro gtor ma dang lha so so'i gtor ma dang bzhi yin no// slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni sngon 'gro gtor ma btang zhing gnas yo byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed gsum sngar ltar bsgoms te bzlas pa ci rigs bya zhing dngos grub blangs nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed cing*/ de las de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim nas sngags cung zad rer bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na chos 'byung gi nang du rang rang gi sa bon las bdag bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul gyis bskyed nas/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang yid las byung ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams bya'o// bstod pa'i mchod pa ni bstod pa so sor byung na yang rung mod/ nā ro mkha' spyod ltar dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa bya'o// gtor ma ni 'dir bya ba'am bdag 'jug tshar rjes byas kyang rung ste/

byin rlabs dus gcig tu byas nas zhal gnyis ma nā ro mkha' spyod dang don 'grub ma la gtor sngags/ oṃ hrīḥhaṃ haṃ he he ho ho he he zhes pa la i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa dang*/ dbu bcad ma la spyi gtor gyi sngags ji bzhin pa gsum gsum gyis 'bul ba sogs mjug 'dra'o// bum bskyed ni bum pa gcig nyid bshams/ de'i nang du sngar gyi gdan lta bu'i steng du zhal gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul du bskyed de/ oṃ gsum ma mang du bzla zhing*/ sngags de'i mjug tu gzhan gnyis kyi sngags dang hūm̐ bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes pa ci mang bzlas so// bzlas pa'i dus kyi dmigs pa ni rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros pas/ bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam zhing bzla'o// 'di la sngar gyi yi ge rnying pa rnams las bum pa bshams te sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa tsam ma gtogs lha bskyed pa'i gsal kha mi snang ngo*// de nas bdag 'jug ni slob ma la bya ba'i skabs dang 'dra'o// slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab nas khyad par gyi dam tshig bzung ba'i bar nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra'o// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon khyod kyis bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab tu gzhug go /de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis slob ma rnams stong par sbyangs te/ de'i ngang las dang por rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma gsal 'debs su bcug cing*/ de'i lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du bam̐ yig gsal btab nas slob dpon rdo rje phag mo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byed du bcug pas/

slob dpon gyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ des slob dpon rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo 'od zer dmar po dang bam̐ yig dmar po'i tshogs byung nas rang rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pas de'i 'od zer gyis sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sems rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes skyes par bsams te/ slob dpon gyis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra res 'jog tu bya/ las kyi rdo rjes gu gul gyi dud pa sogs kyis bdug de bzhin du lha mo gzhan gnyis la lha so sor bskyed pa dang lte bar bam̐ yig dang hrīḥyig bsam pa ma gtogs gzhan 'dra/ de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya/ de nas slob ma re re nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid de/ gdong g.yogs phye nas oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥ zhes rim pa bzhin du gsum gsum brjod cing gtso mo gsum po'i dbu thog tu me tog gi phreng ba phul ba'i mos pa byed du gzhug pa sogs nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar rnal 'byor ma dpal gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab tu gzhug de nas slob dpon gyis oṃ swā bhā wa sogs kyis slob ma rnams stong par sbyangs te/ de'i ngang nas chos 'byung gi nang du rin po che'i khri'i steng du slob ma rnams skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis mar yan lag gsum gyis bskyed pa'i bar 'dra/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod cing slob ma'ang gsal 'debs su bcug slar slob ma rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur pa stsal du gsol/

zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug slob dpon gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon dang bcas pa thams cad kyis shis pa brjod cing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas chu dbang bskur/ lha mo gzhan gnyis la'ang gsol gdab kyi bar 'dra ba las shis brjod mi dgos/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang rtse dgu pa dang rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la mgo bor me tog bzhag cing rab tu gnas pa bya'o// chu dbang gi dus sngags ni/ lha so so'i sngags dang khrus sngags dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags rnams kyis bya'o// bum dbang ngo*// gsang dbang ni sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og na yod pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang rnams slar yang rang rang gi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// zhes sogs brjod cing*/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par sbyin nas myang du bcug pas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par ngo sprad/ gsang dbang ngo*// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni so so'i sngags brjod cing dkyil 'khor so so'i sin+dhu ra slob ma'i srin lag g.yon par sbyin zhing lte bar byug tu bcug pas ye shes thim par bsam zhing*/ deng nas brtsams te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'bral bar ma byed cig ces brjod pa dang dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas te deng nas brtsams te bla ma dang 'bral bar ma byed cig ces brjod do// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// dbang bzhi pa'i rjes gnang ni 'og gi chos bshad pa nyid yin pas/ spyir lta ba la theg chen dang theg dman gnyis/ theg dman la yang nyan rang gi lta ba gnyis/

theg chen la yang sems tsam pa dbu ma pa gsang sngags kyi lta ba dang gsum yod ces go yul tsam bstan nas/ da lan gsang sngags kyi skabs yin la dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi nyams su myong ba'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe gnyis med bde chen ro mnyam du nyams su myang ba tsam yin la/ chos thams cad kyang de lta bu'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so zhes mnyam par 'jog tu 'jug pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas rjes su gnang ba la drug yod kyang*/ lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thang sku lta bu'i sku'i dbyibs snang la rang bzhin med pa zhig sgoms shig ces brjod pa'o// sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni rdo rje phag mo so sor gsal ba'i lte ba nas sngags phreng byung ste rang phag mo so sor gsal ba'i lte bar thim nas sngags kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing sngags so so'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// sogs lan gsum brjod du bcug nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'jug par mdzad du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi mgo bor me tog bzhag go /rjes gnang lhag ma rnams ni yi ge rnying ma'i nang nas 'byung ba ltar don tsam re brjod pas chog go /byin rlabs kyi rjes gnang ni gzhan dang 'dra'o// mjug gi bya ba ni mchod bstod tsam byas nas me long gi sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa rnams rang phag mor gsal ba'i lte bar thim/ rang la go cha drug bkod/ tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba byas te/ bdud rtsi myangs nas bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab cing*/ snang ba lha/ grags pa sngags/ sems kyi rnam rtog rnams ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du shes par byas te spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes pa'i tho yig 'di yang tho yig rnying pa dang*/

gsung sgros kyi tho yig snga ma rnams la gzhi byas te rang gi dran pa gso ba dang don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya dag gis bskul te dge slong puṇ+ya pas bris so// 'di'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lak+ṣiṃ ka ra/ bir+wa pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ sha wa ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa che chung*/ bal po hang du dkar po/ 'di'i gsang mtshan bha ran+t+ra tu tse zer/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ dpyal chos bzang*/ rong pa rga lo/ rong pa shes bzang*/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la gzhung bdun dang rjes gnang gi tho yig rnying pa sgrub thabs kyi tho yig rnying pa rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa legs par gnang ngo*// gzhung bdun po 'di rgyud sde gang la brten na mkha' 'gro ma drwa ba sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces bya ba ni o rgyan na mkha' 'gro'i phyag na yod pa de la brten cing mdzad pa'i slob dpon nam lcam lak+ṣiṃ ka ras dbu bcad ma chung ba'i gzhung mdzad/ des bir+wa pa la gsungs te dbu bcad ma che ba'i gzhung mdzad/ des a wa dhū tī pa la gsungs te don grub ma chung ba'i gzhung mdzad/ des ldong dar la gsungs te yul gyi ming yin la mtshan dngos ni ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'o// des zhal gnyis chung ba'i gzhung gnyis mdzad/ des bsod snyoms pa chung ba la/ de'i mtshan ni ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ de la slob ma gsum yod pa'i lugs la/ mkhas pa de wa a kar tsaṇ+d+ra zhes pa lha'i 'byung gnas zla ba/ gsang mtshan stong nyid ting 'dzin/ zhes pa des zhal gnyis ma chen mo dang don grub ma chen mo'i gzhung gnyis mdzad/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i nye gnas sangs rgyas byin gyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad do// zhes dpyal lugs kyi yig ge rnying pa las 'byung ngo*// 'di la maṇ+ḍal thod pa sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa cha gsum bshams/

slob dpon gyis mngon rtogs gsum bsgom/ mdun du'ang gsum ka mdzad nas mchod pa sogs rgya gzhung so so ltar bya/ bdag 'jug byas/ tshogs 'khor tshar nas slob ma rnams phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sogs 'jug pa rnams gcig tu bya/ ye shes pa 'bebs dus phag mo gsum rer bskyed pa sogs dbang thams cad tha dad du bya/ rjes gnang rnams dus gcig la byed pa dpyal ba'i phyag len du bya/ so sor byung na legs gsung ngo*// ༈ /

dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ byin rlabs cho ga khrigs chags su 'god pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// / ༈ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// phag mo bde ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub thabs gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin// 'dir 'chad mkha' 'gro rnams kyis skabs phyes shig /'dir dad gus dang ldan zhing 'khor lo'i sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa khyad par 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs legs par thob pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bzlas pa rnams spyi ltar/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'dzum bag dang bcas pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs par bsams la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ces brjod/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba thur la zug pa gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yon du bstan pa/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems bam̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i zhal cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa/ g.yas phag zhal sngon po khros shing gyen du gzigs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang mche ba bzhi bzhi spyan gsum dang ldan zhing dbu skra nag po gyen du brdzes pa/ rtse mo ser po thur du 'phyang bas sked sor sleb pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dar 'phyang dang bcas pa mchan khung g.yon na 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brang gis gdan la mnan cing zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i sor mo g.yon gyis brla la gtad pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la bstim/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas tshigs rnams la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin brjod/ lte ba'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha he ru ka yab yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ yid kyis gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ de nas lte ba'i bam̐ las mchod yon me tog la sogs pa thogs pa'i lha mo rnams spros la/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod pa/ lha mo de rnams kyis rang la bstod par bsams la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs brjod/

sngags bzlas ni/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po'i dbus su bam̐/ de'i 'khor yug tu sngags phreng gis skor ba las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib thams cad dag thams cad lhar gyur tshur 'dus/ bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas sdig sgrib dag cing byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzlas rjes bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// 'jig rten mig thur dpyal lo grags pa yis// lugs kyi zhal gnyis ma yi byin rlabs kyi// cho ga tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin du// brjod do snod ldan dga' ba bskyed de nyon// 'di'i byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ gnas dben par yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung la/ sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gsum bshams te/ de yang sku ni maṇ+ḍal gyi khar pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtse mo mdun du bstan pa bri/ gsung ni de'i steng du mañdza'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa bzhag thugs ni me long la sin+dhu ra bkram la chos 'byung gru gsum de'i nang gi phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re/ dbus su bam̐ yig mthar oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng mdun nas g.yon skor du bri/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma zlum po smug rtsi can gcig gam gnyis la sogs pa bshams/ bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba rdor gzungs dang bcas pa/ slob ma la dgos pa'i mig dar me tog dpung skud rnams bshams/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dkyus bzhin du btang la sum+bha ni brjod cing bgegs bsrung*/ gnas yo byin rlabs kyang nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyis sngar bshad pa'i mngon rtogs bzhin bdag bskyed bzlas pa ci nus bya/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsum la dmigs nas sum+bha ni brjod cing bgegs bsang*/

swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su pad nyi ro'i steng du bam̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa'i mngon rtogs bzhin zhal gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs te mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ kha dog lnga ldan sogs 'dod yon lnga dang*/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs yid byung gis mchod/ nang mchod nas 'thor zhing*/ dri chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing yi dam lha rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma sogs kyang mchod/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang*/ spro na yum gyi rkang brgyad kyang bya/ gtor mar dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod bstod pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ bum pa dkyus bzhin bskyed la de'i nang du sngar gyi mdun gyi steng du skad cig gis zhal gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa mdor bsdus bzhin bya oṃ gsum brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzla/ sum+bha ni dang khrus sngags kyang ci rigs bzla/ spro na sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags kyang bzla bar gsungs/ sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lte bar bam̐ yig las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa spros pas bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas sngags kyi 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam zhing bzla/

slar yang mchod bstod dung chos kyi mchod yon phul ba lha zhu ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ bdag 'jug gi slob ma bya ba'i skabs nas 'byung bzhin rang gis blangs/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la zhes sogs khyad par gyi dam tshig bzung ba rnams lan gsum re nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog phreng ba gtad/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal nas slob dpon khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis slob ma bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan la phag mo zhal gnyis ma bskyed/ de'i lte bar bam̐ yig gsal btab/ slob dpon la rdo rje phag mo dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer dmar po dang bam̐ yig dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib dag byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug slob dpon gyis ḍā dril dang bstun oṃ gsum ma bzla/ de brtan byed du tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phreng ba phul ba'i mos pa byed du gzhug me tog de slob ma'i spyi bor 'jog cing rje btsun ma 'di yi dam gyi lhar zungs shig ces brjod/

rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyis// ces sogs dang bstun/ mig dar bkrol/ mngon rtogs ltar lha ngo bstan/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ khyed rang rnams sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su chos 'byung gi nang du rin po che'i khri'i steng du zhal gnyis mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan g.yon du ba dan mtha' skor du mchod pa'i phreng bas bskor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor nas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsung ba zhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod du gzhug sngar bsgrub pa'i bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rongs pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha bstim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la mgo bor me tog gtor/ de dag bum dbang gi rim pa yin/ gsang dbang gi slad du sin+dhu ra'i 'og gi thod chang blangs la oṃ gsum ma brjod cing ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// zhes sogs brjod la slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par bdud rtsi sbyin/ mgrin par myangs pas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des gsang dbang thob pa yin/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ oṃ gsum brjod cing sin+dha ra'i dkyil 'khor nas slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas blangs la slob ma'i srin lag g.yon par sbyin zhing lte bar byugs su gzhug

des mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa khyed rang gi lte bar thim pa'i mos pa gnang*/ deng nas brtsams te rnal 'byor ma dang 'bral bar ma byed cig ces brjod/ yang slob ma'i dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas te/ deng nas brtsams te bla ma dang 'bral bar ma byed cig ces brjod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dbang bzhi pa ni gsum pa'i skabs kyi nyams su myong ba de'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngang du nyams su myong ba tsam yin la/ chos thams cad kyang de lta bu'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par shes par byas la cung zhig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ mthar rten la rjes su gnang ba drug yod pa las/ lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang ni/ deng phyin chad rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa nyin zhag re la thun bzhi'am gsum la sogs pa goms par gyis/ zhes brjod/ gsung bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i lte ba nas sngags phreng byung ste/ khyed rang rnams phag mor gsal ba'i lte bar thim pas sngags kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod du gzhug yang slob dpon gyis slob ma la me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'jug par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ spyod pa ni/ las dang po pa la sogs pa rang rang gi rtog pa dang mthun pa'i las kyis/ gzhan don bya ba'i gnang ba ni/ 'di lta bu'i byin rlabs dang sdom pa la sogs pa skal ldan rnams la sbyin te chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gyis/ bsrung ba dpung skud 'chang ba 'di yin

bsgom pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus go cha'i sngags rnams dran par gyis shig gsung zhing*/ oṃ bam̐ sogs dang*/ phyag g.yon pa'i se gol phyogs bzhir gtogs zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ rjes gtso bos dang maṇ+ḍal sogs 'dra/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ slar yang mdun bskyed mchod bstod yig brgya nongs pa bzod gsol byas nas me long gi sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa rnams rang phag mor gsal ba'i lte bar bstim/ rang la yum gyi go cha drug bkod/ tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba bya zhing*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo// // ༈ /bla ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// phag mo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bsgoms pa'i rim pa ni/ skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar ser gru gsum gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ las gri gug bam̐ gyis mtshan pa gsum yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis nyid kyi dbu bcad nas phyag g.yon thod pa dang bcas pa dbu skra'i phyed bzung zhing phyed kyis zhal bkab pa thur du gzigs pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i g.yon du rab bsngags ma ljang gu zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa/ phyag g.yas thod pa dang g.yon gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yas su rnam snang ma ser mo zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum la phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo dbu skra grol ba/ zhal cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'di'i bdag bskyed la ye shes pa gzhug pa dang dbang bskur ba mi dgos par bshad/

de nas gsum ka'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gi dbus su gtso mo/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ rab bsngags ma la/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam snang la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsā nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas rang rang gi chos 'byung du bkod la gsal gdab/ de nas 'og rlung 'then pas chos 'byung gi sngags las 'od zer byung bas rtsa gsum nas gyen du song ba phyir 'phros/ 'khor gyi lha mo gnyis la phog pas 'od du zhu nas gtso mo la thim/ nyid kyi dbu yang 'byar/ gtso mo gsang gnas su sngags gsum ma 'dres pa sum bsgrigs su yod par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la sngags gsum po ci nus bzlas/ bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ 'di'i byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung dmar ser gru gsum gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar zla nyi'i steng du gri gug bri ba ni sku'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhag pa ni gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ra bkram la chos 'byung gru gsum de'i nang gi phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re/ dbus su gsum lha'i bzhugs tshul ltar bsgrigs su 'bri ba ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi mtha' skor mdun du mchod gtor bum pa la sogs zhal gnyis ma ltar bshams/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs lha gsum gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha gsum bdag bskyed bzhin la gtso mo dbu ma bcad pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ gzhan rnams mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ zhal gnyis ma ltar ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ go cha bkod/ gtso mo la rnam snang gi rigs bdag rang chas su bzhugs par bsgoms/

de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung gtor ma'i bar phal cher zhal gnyis ma'i 'gros sbyar bas shes/ 'di'i gtor ma byin rlabs nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags ji lta ba bzhin gyis lan gsum phul/ bum bskyed ni bum nang gi lha gsum bskyed cing yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya/ 'di'i sngags tshan pa gsum po bzla/ gzhan sngar gyi 'gros sbyar bas shes/ bdag 'jug nas bzung gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyi bar lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs phal cher zhal gnyis ma'i 'gros sbyar/ 'di dang don grub ma gnyis la bum chus dbang bskur ba'i tshe shis brjod la sogs pa mi dgos/ 'di la chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas me tog 'thor zhing su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs dang*/ dbang gong ma gsum dang mtha' rten rjes gnang drug rnams zhal gnyis ma'i skabs ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i rjes gnang gi tshe 'di'i sngags gsum po brjod/ mjug gi mchod gtor sogs kyang rigs 'gre'o/ ༈ /bla ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// don grub ma bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ skyabs sems yig brgya nas swa bhā wa'i bar dkyus bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma dang ro'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig phag zhal khros pa ljags 'dril zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na thod khrag dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na gdug pa can gyis bzod par dka' ba'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing bzhugs pa'o// de la ye shes pa gzhug

go cha bkod/ dbang lha spyan drangs la dbang bskur/ sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas btab/ bzlas pa ni/ de ltar du gsal ba'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gi nang du oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi a we sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa bkod la 'od zer gyi spro bsdus don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsams la/ sngags de brgya rtsa la sogs par bzla/ bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab bo// 'di'i byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ sngon 'gro'i bsham la chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma dang ro'i steng du hrīḥyig lcags kyu bri ba ni sku'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng mañdzu'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba ni gsung*/ de steng me long gi ngos la sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung gru gsum nang gi phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa'i dod la rdo rje rgya gram bzhi bris/ dbus su 'di'i rtsa sngags bris pa ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi mtha' skor du mchod gtor bum pa tshul bzhin bshams pa sogs gnyis dang 'dra/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang la mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum gyi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar gdan bkod pa nas bzung*/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzung bstod pa'i bar zhal gnyis ma bzhin bya/ gtor ma bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa'am bsdu na sngar bshad pa bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di'i sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pas bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams gong gi 'gres sbyar bas shes/ de nas bum bskyed don grub ma rang gi lha sngags sbyar/

gzhan sngar bzhin/ bdag 'jug 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin blangs/ de nas slob ma phyag byas la gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu maṇ+ḍal/ dga' chen khyod bdag nas bzung dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas par zhal gnyis ma'i rigs 'gres sbyar bas shes/ mtha' rten drug ba bsrung ba bsgom pa la dpung skud dmar po slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par nyis skor du bcings te mdud pa'i steng phyag gi rdo rje bzhag ste oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod pa mdzad/ 'di snga ma gnyis kyi skabs su'ang byung na legs te yig rnying dang mthun no// rjes gtso bos sogs dang*/ mjug gi mchod bstod sogs kyang sngar gyi rigs 'gre/ 'di ni rkang thon du so sor bskur ba'i lugs yin la/ sdebs gcig la bskur na maṇ+ḍal thod pa sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa cha gsum bshams/ slob dpon mngon rtogs sum rim can du bsgom/ mdun du yang gsum ka rim can du bskyed nas mchod bstod thun mong du bya'o// gtor ma yang rang rang gi sngags la mtha' rten gyi sngags btags pas phul/ bum bskyed zhal gnyis ma bskyed nas lha gsum ka'i sngags bzla/ bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma rnams la maṇ+ḍal sogs 'jug pa rnams dus gcig la bya/ ye shes pa 'bebs dus phag mo gsum po re re bskyed la so sor 'bebs pa dbang thams cad la bya/ lha ngo yang tha dad du bstan dgos/ rjes gnang rnams dus gcig la byed

de tshe lha gsum gyi bzlas lung sdebs la byed/ pa dpyal ba'i phyag len la yod/ so sor 'byung na legs gsungs te yig rnying las gnyis ka bshad do// 'di'i rten gzhi'i rgyud ni/ mkha' 'gro ma drwa ba sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces bya ba/ o rgyan na mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na yod pa de la brten nas lcam lak+ṣiṃ ka ra sogs kyis rim bzhin du phag mo skor gsum gyi gzhung rnams mdzad pa yin no// zhes dpyal lugs kyi yi ge rnying pa las 'byung ngo zhes glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub pas gsungs so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lak+ṣiṃ ka ra/ bram ze bir+wa pa/ slob dpon a wa dhū tī pa/ grub chen ldang dar ba ting 'dzin bzang po/ bal po bha ran+t+ra hang du dkar po yang zer tu tse/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ zar ston a tsār+ya/ gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ dbus pa shes rab rdo rje/ lce thams cad mkhyen pa mdo sde seṅge/ gru shākya 'bum/ lce blo ldan seṅge/ lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ spos khang pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dga' ldong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag la yig lung dang bcas pa'i chos skor kun tshang bar gnang ba lags/ de ltar phag mo zhal gnyis ma sogs la phag zhal dngos su yod pas rdo rje phag mor 'jog pa 'thad mod/ gzhan nā ro mkha' spyod sogs la phag zhal med pas phag mor 'jog pa mi rigs so snyam pa'i dogs pa dpyod ldan la 'byung la rang gi bsam tshod zhal gnyis ma 'di ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i lha dang gzhan 'dir bshad pa'i sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang mai tri mkha' spyod la sogs la/

phag zhal dngos su med kyang zhal gnyis ma rtsa bar byas nas de la gyes pa lta bu'i lha yin pas phag mo bzhag pa yin te/ sgrub thabs rnams kyi nang nas kyang zhal gnyis ma 'di thog mar byung zhing*/ rnal 'byor ma gzhan gyi sgrub thabs 'di'i rjes su 'byung ba yin no// de skad rje btsun grags pa'i rnal 'byor byang seng gis dris lan las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu'i rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs las zhes gsungs pas shes nus so// mdor na phag mo gzhan rnams ni phag mo rigs las byung pa phag mor bzhag pa yin no// rgyud rgyal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i don// legs smin ka ra sogs kyis legs bkral ba'i// dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum byin rlabs kyi// cho ga mi nub yun du dar gyur cig /de ltar phag mo mkha' spyod kyi cho ga khrigs chags 'di ni spang khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil dang glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la brten/ rje bla ma sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dbang phyug rab brtan gyis ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag bzhed kyis brgyan nas/ rje btsun bla ma'i bran du gyur pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis chu mo bya lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes la bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan la 'tsho zhing bzhes par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
